summary: Role-based permission gating on Sale Invoice screens verified end-to-end. CORE SCOPE PASSES 100%: (A) Admin sees all 3 action buttons in both list row (print-<id>, edit-<id>, del-<id>) and detail header (print-hdr, edit-hdr, del-hdr); admin print opens PDF at /api/invoices/inv_f44f20f2ac07/pdf?token=... (captured via context.on('request')), admin edit navigates to /accounting/invoices/new?edit_id=inv_f44f20f2ac07&type=sale with the form pre-filled (SI-0029, customer TEST_Cust_bca95bde, item DSC ₹1000, Paid ₹400, Balance ₹600). (B) Employee sees ONLY Print in both list row and detail header — edit-<id>, del-<id>, edit-hdr, del-hdr all have count=0 (element not rendered, per isAdmin gate). Employee print-hdr also fires the correct /pdf?token=... request. (C) Direct URL guard: employee can navigate to /accounting/invoices/new?edit_id=<id> and the form renders; clicking Save issues a PATCH which backend rejects with HTTP 403 (defense-in-depth working). SECONDARY FINDINGS (NOT blockers for this bug's scope): React-Native Alert.alert() on react-native-web is a NO-OP — (a) admin del-hdr click does not surface the 'Delete Invoice?' confirmation dialog on web (no native browser dialog fired, no role=alertdialog rendered, body text unchanged); (b) employee PATCH 403 fails silently — no user-facing 'Forbidden'/'Failed' alert surfaced. Both are the same underlying rn-web Alert issue and only manifest on the web preview; native builds would render properly. Flagged as low-priority polish per the review request's own guidance. No React-Native red-screen, no console errors, no navigation crashes. All 3 numbered scenarios in A and B pass; C's core assertion (403 from backend) confirmed while friendly-error UX is missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert() invoked on web renders nothing (no native dialog, no rn-web modal). Delete-confirmation flow is broken on the web preview for both list and detail delete actions. Reference: /app/frontend/app/accounting/invoices/[id].tsx:33 and /app/frontend/app/accounting/invoices/index.tsx:35. Consider using a cross-platform confirm (custom Modal or web-only window.confirm fallback).

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly returns HTTP 403 on PATCH /api/invoices/{id} for employee (verified via context request listener), but the failure is silent — no Alert / toast / friendly error surfaces because Alert.alert('Failed', ...) is a no-op on react-native-web. User sees no feedback that save was rejected. Reference: /app/frontend/app/accounting/invoices/new.tsx save handler. Priority: low-priority polish per review request; core defense-in-depth (backend 403) works.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish (low priority): Replace Alert.alert() with a cross-platform confirm/error component so (a) admin delete-invoice confirmation works on web preview, and (b) employee attempting to save via direct URL sees a friendly 'You do not have permission…' message instead of a silent 403. Files: /app/frontend/app/accounting/invoices/[id].tsx (line 33), /app/frontend/app/accounting/invoices/index.tsx (line 35), and the save handler in /app/frontend/app/accounting/invoices/new.tsx. A simple pattern: `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (window.confirm(msg)) doDelete(); } else { Alert.alert(...) }` and similarly a rn-web-visible error banner/toast on save failure.
critical_code_review_comments: InvoicesList (index.tsx:97-108) and InvoiceDetail (id.tsx:50-55) both correctly gate edit/delete rendering with `isAdmin` derived from `useAuth().user?.role === 'admin'`. Employee sees only Print — confirmed by DOM count=0 for edit-<id>/del-<id>/edit-hdr/del-hdr.
Backend enforces admin-only PATCH on /api/invoices/{id} (returns 403 for employee) — confirmed at network layer. Frontend gating and backend RBAC are consistent; defense-in-depth achieved.

React-Native Alert.alert is used for both delete confirmation AND error surfacing (Alert.alert('Failed', …)). On react-native-web this is a no-op → any Alert-based user feedback is invisible on the web preview. Recommend a shared cross-platform confirm/toast utility to avoid this pitfall repeating across the codebase.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs: input-email / input-password / submit-btn. Logout via /(tabs)/more → testID `logout-btn`. Invoice list rows use testID `inv-<id>` with action buttons `print-<id>`, `edit-<id>`, `del-<id>`. Detail header buttons: `print-hdr`, `edit-hdr`, `del-hdr`. For role-based visibility assertions, prefer `page.get_by_test_id(...).count() == 0` over click-and-timeout. IMPORTANT: React-Native Alert.alert() on react-native-web is a NO-OP — do NOT rely on `page.on('dialog')` or `[role="alertdialog"]` selectors for delete confirms or error messages; they will never fire. To capture backend PDF/API calls made by window.open in a popup, use `page.context.on('request', ...)` (context-level) — page-level listeners miss popup traffic. First invoice id in the seeded list is `inv_f44f20f2ac07` (SI-0029, Credit, TEST_Cust_bca95bde, DSC line ₹1000, Paid 400).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is verification, not bug-fix. Product-behavior gap observed: Alert.alert() on react-native-web renders nothing (neither a native browser confirm nor an rn-web modal). Root cause: react-native-web's Alert module does not ship a visible fallback; buttons array is ignored. Impact scope: admin delete-invoice confirm on web preview, and error/toast surfacing after failed API calls. Mitigation: wrap Alert.alert usage with `Platform.select` — on web use window.confirm for confirms and a persistent in-app banner/toast for errors; on native keep Alert.alert.
